briefdescription.para: Inserts Ptr if and only if there is no element in the container equal to Ptr.

detaileddescription.para: The bool component of the returned pair is true if and only if the insertion takes place, and the iterator component of the pair points to the element equal to Ptr.

briefdescription.para: Insert the given pointer with an iterator hint that is ignored.

detaileddescription.para: This is identical to calling insert(Ptr), but allows SmallPtrSet to be used by std::insert_iterator and std::inserter().
Returns whether the pointer was in the set. Invalidates iterators if true is returned. To remove elements while iterating over the set, use remove_if() instead.

briefdescription.para: Remove elements that match the given predicate.

detaileddescription.para: Returns whether anything was removed. It is safe to read the set inside the predicate function. However, the predicate must not modify the set itself, only indicate a removal by returning true.

briefdescription.para: count - Return 1 if the specified pointer is in the set, 0 otherwise.
Create an iterator that dereferences to same place as the given pointer.

briefdescription.para: A templated base class for SmallPtrSet which provides the typesafe interface that is common across all small sizes.

detaileddescription.para: This is particularly useful for passing around between interface boundaries to avoid encoding a particular small size in the interface boundary.
